home.heroTitle:
Science-Based Ruminant Nutrition.
From Research to the Farm.
home.heroSubtitle: I work in ruminant nutrition — dairy cow feeding, feed additives, and transition cow management — translating peer-reviewed research into practical, farm-ready decisions.
home.aboutStripTitle: I'm Tolga Akay, an animal nutritionist working at the intersection of research and practice.
home.aboutStripBody: Currently R&D Coordinator and Lab Manager at Global Nutritech, and pursuing graduate studies in animal nutrition. This site is where I publish the technical thinking that doesn't fit in a lab report: rumen physiology, transition cow management, feed evaluation, and the everyday judgment calls that separate a good ration on paper from one that works in the bunk.

about.title: About
about.bodyP1: I'm an animal nutritionist working in ruminant and dairy cattle nutrition, currently serving as R&D Coordinator and Lab Manager at Global Nutritech, where I lead applied research and laboratory analysis supporting feed and feed-additive development. My work sits at the intersection of controlled research and the day-to-day realities of commercial dairy farms — which is the perspective I bring to everything published here.
about.bodyP2: I'm currently pursuing a graduate degree with a focus on deepening my expertise in ruminant nutrition, particularly dairy cattle feeding systems. My interest in this field started with a simple frustration: how much published science never makes it into a form a farm can actually use. This site exists to close that gap — one technical article, one worksheet, one honest answer at a time.

ask.title: Have a Nutrition Question?
ask.body: I read every question submitted here personally. If yours is a common, general question, I may answer it publicly as a Research Note (with all identifying details removed) so others benefit too — let me know in the form if you'd prefer your question stay private. For farm-specific or urgent situations, please also consult your veterinarian or on-farm nutritionist directly; this is a supplementary resource, not an emergency channel.
ask.faqQuestion0: What kinds of questions can I ask?
ask.faqAnswer0: Anything within ruminant and dairy cattle nutrition — ration evaluation, transition cow feeding, DCAD, rumen health, feed additives, TMR management, and related topics. Highly farm-specific or urgent situations are better handled directly with your veterinarian or on-farm nutritionist alongside anything I can add here.
ask.faqAnswer1: Only if it is general enough to help others, and only with all identifying details removed. Check "keep this private" on the form if you would prefer your question isn't used publicly under any circumstances.
ask.faqQuestion2: How long does it take to hear back?
ask.faqAnswer2: I read every submission personally. Response time varies, but I aim to reply directly within a few business days where a specific reply is appropriate.

consultancy.title: Collaborate With Me
consultancy.body: I work with dairy farms, veterinarians, feed companies, and agribusinesses on a focused set of technical questions in ruminant nutrition. My approach starts from the same place published research does: look at the data, question the assumptions, and recommend only what the evidence actually supports for your specific situation.
consultancy.stepText0: A short call or written exchange to understand your situation and whether I'm the right fit.
consultancy.stepText1: I review your ration, feed analyses, or the specific question at hand.
consultancy.stepText2: You receive clear, evidence-based findings — not a generic report template.
consultancy.closing: If you're not sure whether your question fits here, ask — I'd rather have a short conversation than have you guess.

disclaimer.title: Educational Purpose Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: The content published on this website — including articles, technical guides, research notes, downloadable resources, and any responses provided through the "Ask a Question" feature — is intended for general educational and informational purposes only. It reflects the author's professional interpretation of peer-reviewed research and field experience in ruminant and dairy cattle nutrition.
disclaimer.p2: Nothing on this site constitutes individualized veterinary, nutritional, or agronomic advice for any specific animal, herd, or farm operation. Feeding programs, ration formulations, and health-related decisions should always be made in consultation with a licensed veterinarian or a qualified animal nutrition professional who has direct knowledge of your herd, feed inventory, and farm conditions.
disclaimer.p3: Use of any calculator, worksheet, or checklist provided on this site does not replace professional assessment and is provided "as is," without warranty of any kind. The author and this website assume no liability for outcomes resulting from the independent application of information found here.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This page explains what information this site collects, why, and how it's handled. It applies to tolgaakay.com and its subpages.
privacyPolicy.collectItem0: Information you submit through the Ask a Question, Collaborate, or Contact forms (name, email, country, profession, and your message or question).
privacyPolicy.collectItem1: Files you choose to upload with a question (rations, feed analyses, photos, or documents).
privacyPolicy.collectItem2: Your email address, if you subscribe to the newsletter.
privacyPolicy.collectItem3: Basic, privacy-respecting analytics events (page views, referrers) — no cross-site tracking, no ad identifiers.
privacyPolicy.whyBody: Solely to respond to your inquiry, to send the newsletter if you've opted in, and to understand, in aggregate, how the site is used so it can be improved. Your data is never sold, and never used for advertising.
privacyPolicy.howLongBody: Form submissions and any attachments are retained for up to 12 months to support follow-up correspondence, then deleted. You can request earlier deletion at any time by emailing tolgaakay616@gmail.com.
privacyPolicy.newsletterBody: Subscribing requires confirming your email address (double opt-in). Every newsletter email includes a one-click unsubscribe link.
privacyPolicy.fileUploadsBody: Attachments submitted with a question are stored privately and are not publicly accessible. Some material submitted this way — rations, feed analyses — may be commercially sensitive to your operation, and is treated accordingly: viewed only as needed to respond to your question.
privacyPolicy.rightsBody: You can ask, at any time, what data is held about you, request a correction, or request deletion, by emailing tolgaakay616@gmail.com.
